text: Which Tyneside town is hidden in this sentence: 'She filled each jar row by row'?
why: Read across the words: 'jar row' hides J-A-R-R-O-W.

text: The Angel of the North is 20 metres tall and its wings are 54 metres across. How many metres wider is it than it is tall?
Change one letter of TYNE to make a word for a prong on a fork.
why: Swap the Y in TYNE for an I to get TINE, a fork's prong.

text: Seven bridges cross the Tyne between Newcastle and Gateshead. You start in Newcastle and cross every one exactly once. Which side of the river do you finish on?
why: Each crossing switches sides, and after an odd number, seven, you are on the opposite side to where you started.
